dynamic.avg_monthly_credit_amount: Average amount credited to the account per month
dynamic.avg_monthly_withdrawal_amount: Average amount debited from the account per month
dynamic.avg_monthly_net_flow: Average monthly net flow (credit minus withdrawal)
dynamic.avg_monthly_credit_count: Average number of credit transactions per month
dynamic.avg_monthly_withdrawal_count: Average number of withdrawal transactions per month
dynamic.monthly_withdrawal_count_variance: Month-to-month variability in withdrawal transaction count
dynamic.monthly_credit_count_variance: Month-to-month variability in credit transaction count
dynamic.monthly_atm_txn_count: Average number of ATM transactions per month
dynamic.monthly_web_txn_count: Average number of web/app transactions per month
dynamic.monthly_cash_txn_count: Average number of cash transactions per month
dynamic.monthly_weekday_txn_pct: Share of transactions that occur on weekdays (0-100)
dynamic.monthly_weekend_txn_pct: Share of transactions that occur on weekends (0-100)
